convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for the FigurelliSeries indicator which is not a built-in MT5 indicator, and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution logic (open/close positions, lot calculation, global variable cleanup).

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for indicator calculation

other_exits: Time-based exit: positions closed when tm.hour==StopHour && tm.min>=StopMinute, or tm.hour>StopHour, or tm.hour<StartHour
Opposite signal closes existing position: FigurelliSeries > 0 triggers SELL_Close if SellPosClose enabled; FigurelliSeries < 0 triggers BUY_Close if BuyPosClose enabled

position_sizing.conditional_logic: When MMMode=LOT, MM is treated as fixed lot size; otherwise MM is the share/fraction of deposit used for lot calculation based on MarginMode enumeration

custom_logic_notes: Entry signals are generated only on new bars (or when SignalBar==0 which allows intrabar recalculation). However, actual trade entry is gated by a specific time window: BUY_Open1/SELL_Open1 must be true AND current time must match StartHour:StartMinute exactly. This means the EA only enters positions at one specific minute per day. Exit by time is broader: closes all positions when time reaches or passes StopHour:StopMinute, or is before StartHour. The FigurelliSeries indicator outputs a single value: positive = bullish, negative = bearish, compared against zero line. Signal is read from bar index SignalBar (default=1, previous bar). Time-based close overrides signal-based close.
python_conversion_notes: The FigurelliSeries custom indicator must be replicated in Python - it computes iTotal (36) Moving Averages starting from iStartPeriod (6) with step iStep (6), so periods are 6,12,18,...,216. The aggregate series value determines direction (above/below zero). TradeAlgorithms.mqh functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar) must all be reimplemented. The time-gated entry logic (only at StartHour:StartMinute) is unusual and must be preserved exactly. SL/TP of 1000/2000 points likely need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers (multiply by 10). The MarginMode enum from TradeAlgorithms.mqh controls 5 different lot calculation methods that all need implementation.
